content.short: Topper is a fiat onramp by Uphold for buying and selling 200+ cryptocurrencies to self-custody wallets.
content.description: Topper buys and sells more than 200 cryptocurrencies directly to and from a self-custodial wallet. A user enters a destination address, pays by card and receives the assets without an account balance in between. Recurring purchases can be scheduled weekly or monthly to the same address. Every asset Topper supports for buying can also be sold back through it.
